courses.name: IELTS Full Batch
courses.continuation: 2 to 3 included classes after the regular course
courses.description: Structured IELTS preparation from foundation to all four modules.
benefits: Grammar foundation and all four IELTS modules
One year of recordings and e-learning access
faq: I am a beginner. Can I join?
The course includes Grammar and foundation preparation. Tell us your current level so we can help you decide whether this batch is suitable.
What if I miss a class?
Live attendance is recommended. You can watch the recording through your learning website access.
Is an unlimited practice portal included?
No separate unlimited practice portal is included in the IELTS Full Batch.

courses.name: PTE Crash Batch
courses.continuation: 2 to 3 included classes after the regular course
courses.description: Focused PTE preparation with instructor feedback and exam techniques.
benefits: Grammar foundation and PTE four skills
Question types, scoring priorities and exam techniques
One year of recordings and e-learning access
One month unlimited PTE practice portal access
faq: I am new to PTE. Can I join?
The course includes foundation support. Tell us about your English level and exam plans so we can guide you.
How long is unlimited practice access?
The separate PTE practice portal is included for one month. Activation dates are confirmed when access is issued.
What if I miss a class?
You can review recorded classes, although live attendance is recommended.
